question:
Create a new KiCad project named b07 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build an SN74AVC4T774RSVR four-channel dual-supply level-translator breakout using the supplied symbol and footprint. Provide independent VCCA and VCCB inputs, all four A/B signal pairs, all four direction controls and active-low output enable. Use two 1x8, 2.54 mm headers. Header A pins 1-8 are VCCA, A1, A2, A3, A4, DIR1, DIR2, nOE; header B pins 1-8 are VCCB, B1, B2, B3, B4, DIR3, DIR4, GND. Include local 100 nF decoupling for each supply. Direction and enable are host-controlled, so expose them without fixed straps.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local symbol library (SN74AVC4T774.kicad_sym) and footprint library (SN74AVC4T774.pretty) in lib/ under the project directory; use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.
